description: This Swift source file provides extensions to the 'CronSettings' class, adding various SwiftUI view components for displaying and interacting with CronJob objects and their associated data, such as job rows, context menus, detail headers, detail cards, run history, and payload summaries.

methods.name: jobRow
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI view representing a job row with job name, status, and controls.

methods.name: jobContextMenu
methods.description: Provides a context menu with actions for a specific CronJob such as run, open transcript, enable/disable, edit, and delete.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Constructs a detailed header view for a specific CronJob, including its name, ID, enable toggle, and action buttons.

methods.name: detailCard
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a CronJob, including schedule, description, agent, session, wake mode, last run, status, errors, and payload.

methods.name: runHistoryCard
methods.description: Shows the run history of a CronJob, including refresh capability and list of run entries.

methods.name: runRow
methods.description: Represents a single run log entry as a SwiftUI view, showing status, date, duration, summary, and error.

methods.name: payloadSummary
methods.description: Displays a summary of the job payload, including system events and agent turn messages.
